inventory.visualPurpose: The two-panel G-protein cascade figure (book 237): the Gq route (phospholipase C → PIP2 → DAG + IP3 → Ca2+ → smooth muscle contraction) and the shared-enzyme Gs/Gi route (adenylyl cyclase stimulated by GS protein, inhibited by Gi protein; ATP → cAMP → PKA → ↑Ca2+ and ⊣ myosin light-chain kinase)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: VECTOR LINE ART, ZERO rasters (pdfimages CONFIRMED; VLM seven passes 120–432 DPI + PyMuPDF word/vector-path dump, saved to staging-ph14/): TWO STACKED PANELS. TOP — the Gq cascade: Ligand (pink circle) → 'H1, α1, V1, M1, or M3 receptor' (7-TM) → Gq protein → ⊕ Phospholipase C → ⊕ PIP2 (hexagon) → DAG (right, → ⊕ Protein kinase C) and IP3 (down, → ↑Ca2+ → both ⊕ Protein kinase C and 'Smooth muscle contraction'); all arrows pointed/stimulatory. BOTTOM — the shared-enzyme panel: one Ligand label (the right arm's ligand circle unlabeled), 'B1, B2, B3, D1, H2, or V2 receptor' (Latin B as printed) → GS protein → pointed green ⊕ onto the central Adenylyl cyclase; 'M2, α2, or D2 receptor' → Gi protein → blunt red ⊖ T-bar ONTO THE SAME Adenylyl cyclase; ATP (starburst) → Cyclic AMP (circle cluster) → Protein kinase A → green ⊕ leftward onto ↑Ca2+ and blunt red ⊖ rightward onto 'Myosin light-chain kinase (smooth muscle contraction)'. Environment labels print twice per panel's left edge: Extracellular space / Cell membrane / Cytoplasm.
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual's TWO CASCADE PANELS (GProteinMessengerMap in visuals/pharm-p14.tsx): the Gq panel redrawn as a KYP glyph chain (ligand circle → hatched membrane + 7-TM receptor glyph → Gq protein → Phospholipase C → PIP2 hexagon → the DAG/PKC and IP3/↑Ca2+/smooth-muscle-contraction fork, green ⊕ markers on the stimulatory arrows) and the shared-enzyme panel (two receptors in one membrane, GS protein's ⊕ and Gi protein's blunt red T-bar ⊖ onto the one Adenylyl cyclase, ATP → Cyclic AMP → Protein kinase A, PKA's ⊕ to ↑Ca2+ and blunt red ⊖ to Myosin light-chain kinase), with the environment labels preserved on each panel's left edge as printed

notes: TWO visual assets on the source page, both accounted for: [1] the RECEPTOR / G-PROTEIN CLASS / MAJOR FUNCTIONS table — an ORIGINAL KYP ADAPTATION (the registry visual's q/i/s swimlane directory + the verbatim table block in the note, printed row order, with the source's own red-printed '(one heart)' / '(two lungs)' / 'twobules (tubules)' hints carried attributed); [2] the two-panel cascade figure — an ORIGINAL KYP REDRAW (the visual's two glyph-chain panels, every printed label preserved, both inhibitory arrows drawn as blunt red T-bars with ⊖ markers exactly where the page prints them: Gi protein onto adenylyl cyclase, and Protein kinase A onto myosin light-chain kinase). Census: ZERO raster images (pdfimages, CONFIRMED); VLM (glm-4.6v) ran seven passes this session (120–432 DPI) plus a PyMuPDF word/vector-path dump — the figure is pure vector line art, no photographs, no margin notes or mnemonics anywhere on the page.
